name: Hierarchical Voxel Traversal with Portal Teleportation
definition: A ray traversal algorithm that navigates a hierarchical voxel structure (octree) to find surface intersections, supporting teleportation through portals defined in the voxel data.
summary: Hierarchical Voxel Traversal with Portal Teleportation is a ray traversal algorithm that navigates octrees to find intersections while seamlessly jumping rays between disconnected spatial regions via portal teleportation.
